blurb: Guests check in at the Lompoc facility for a brief training session before a scenic flight over the California coast. They then jump from their chosen altitude up to 18,000 feet, experiencing freefall followed by a parachute ride back to the landing area. The dropzone offers views of Vandenberg Space Force Base, Santa Ynez Valley wine country, and the Pacific Ocean.
extraNote: Perfect safety record; all jumpmasters are U.S.P.A. rated; aircraft and pilots are F.A.A. certified · Lompoc facility
